label: lehome-rollout-builder
on-start: apk add --no-cache bash git curl >/var/log/build-prep.log 2>&1; (docker-entrypoint.sh dockerd >>/var/log/dockerd.log 2>&1 &); for i in $(seq 1 90); do docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 2; done; docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'dockerd failed to start' >&2; exit 1; }; git clone --depth 1 --branch ${BUILD_BRANCH:-ryanjin333/vast-rollout} https://github.com/ryanjin333/lehome-challenge.git /tmp/src && cd /tmp/src/docker/rollout && IMAGE_TAG=${IMAGE_TAG:-ryanjin333/lehome-rollout:latest} PUSH=1 ./build.sh 2>&1 | tee /var/log/image-build.log; echo 'BUILD DONE (rc='$?') — safe to destroy this instance once the push completed'
